meta.title: Fudaristo — Fantasy Ελλάδα
meta.description: Fantasy football for the Greek Super League

home.headline: Run your club through the Greek Super League.
home.pitch: Pick your squad, choose a captain, follow every player through the season — like a real manager, not a spectator.
home.pitchReturning: Check your lineup before the deadline, track points and see where you stand.
home.step1Body: Pick 15 players on a 100M budget — a real transfer window.
home.step2Body: Your captain scores double. Set your starting XI before the deadline.
home.step3Body: Watch your team score from real Greek Super League matches.

auth.forgotIntro: Enter the email you registered with. We'll send you a link to set a new password.
auth.checkMailBody: If an account exists for {email}, a link to set a new password is on its way. It is valid for one hour and can be used once.
auth.checkSpam: Don't see it? Check your spam folder.
auth.linkInvalid: That link is invalid or has expired. Request a new one below.
auth.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
auth.sendFailed: Sending failed. Try again in a minute.
auth.passwordTooShort: Password must be at least 6 characters.
auth.passwordSame: The new password must differ from the old one.
auth.passwordFailed: Password was not changed. Request a new link and try again.
auth.signsOutOthers: Saving the password signs out all other devices.
auth.linkOnlyFromEmail: This page opens from a link in your email. The link is valid for one hour and can be used only once — if you already used it or it expired, request a new one.
auth.linkExpired: That link has expired. Request a new one.
auth.linkBroken: That link is not valid. Request a new one.

league.title: Global league
league.subtitle: Every team in Fudaristo, ranked by total fantasy points.
league.noFinalized: No gameweek has been finalised yet, so every score is zero. The table comes alive once the first gameweek is scored.

stats.title: Stats
stats.subtitle: Greek Super League top charts, through fantasy points.
stats.noData: No points have been calculated yet. The charts fill up once the first gameweek is scored.
stats.noGoals: No goals have been recorded yet.
stats.noAssists: No assists have been recorded yet.
stats.noClubPoints: Club totals appear once players start scoring points.
stats.noPositionPoints: Points appear once the first gameweek is scored.

fixtures.title: Fixtures and results
fixtures.subtitle: Every gameweek of the Greek Super League, first to last.
fixtures.noGameweeks: No gameweeks have been imported yet.
fixtures.noFixturesInGameweek: No matches have been imported for this gameweek yet.

errors.unknown: Unknown error — check the Vercel logs.
errors.staleSchema: If the message mentions a relationship between tables (relationship, PGRST200), Supabase has a stale schema cache after a migration. Run in the SQL Editor: notify pgrst, 'reload schema';
errors.friendly: Try refreshing the page in a moment.

chips.title: Chips
chips.rule: One per gameweek · each once a season
chips.needsFavorite: Pick a favourite club in settings
chips.tripleCaptainBlurb: Your captain scores triple instead of double.
chips.favoriteClubBlurb: Every player from your favourite club scores double.
chips.joker1Blurb: Unlimited transfers, no penalty. Opens during the winter break.
chips.joker2Blurb: Unlimited transfers, no penalty. Opens before the play-offs.

pitch.benchNote: Bench order decides who comes on first if a player doesn't play a single minute.
pitch.autoSubbedIn: Auto-sub: came on for a player with no minutes

picker.noMatch: No player matches these filters. Try a wider price limit or another club.

settings.title: My settings
settings.subtitle: Your team name and colour are shown to other managers in the league table.
settings.nameTaken: That team name is taken — pick another.
settings.favoriteNote: Has no effect on fantasy rules — it only shows on your profile.

register.nameTaken: That team name is taken — try another.
register.title: Create your club
register.subtitle: Takes under a minute — no email verification.
register.noClubsWarning: No clubs in the database yet — run faza1-run-in-supabase.sql in the Supabase SQL Editor before registering.
register.signUpFailed: Registration failed. Try again in a minute.
register.emailTaken: An account with that email already exists — log in instead.
register.throttled: Too many new accounts in the last hour. Try again shortly.
register.invalidInput: Check the fields — something isn't filled in correctly.
register.signInFailed: The account was created but sign-in failed. Try logging in.
register.captchaFailed: The anti-bot check did not pass. Refresh the page and try again.

publicTeam.noFinalized: No gameweek has been finalised yet. Squads become public only once a gameweek is scored — before the deadline another manager's team is secret.
publicTeam.noSquad: This team had no squad in gameweek {number}.

adminDenied.title: Admin panel
adminDenied.noAccess: You don't have access to this page.
adminDenied.noProfile: Your account has no profile in the users table. That only happens if registration was interrupted — sign out and register again.
adminDenied.accountNoAdmin: The account {team} does not have admin rights. For security reasons nobody can grant themselves is_admin — the column is locked at the privilege level (migration 003), so neither an RLS policy nor this app can allow it.
adminDenied.setOnce: It is set once, in the Supabase SQL Editor:
adminDenied.afterRefresh: Then refresh the page — the "Admin" link will appear in the navigation.

team.selling: Selling {name} for {price}. You can spend up to {budget} on the replacement.
team.captainToBench: The captain moved to the bench — pick a new one.
team.viceToBench: The vice-captain moved to the bench — pick a new one.
team.notEnoughFor: You don't have enough players for {formation} ({position}: need {need}, have {have}).
team.formationApplied: Formation {formation}. The armband moved to a player who stayed in the XI — check your pick.
team.xiSize: The starting XI must have {size} players (currently {count}).
team.maxPerClub: At most {max} players from one club — {club}: {count}.
team.transfersFailed: Transfers were not applied — refresh the page and try again.
team.transfersSavedLineupNot: Transfers were saved but the lineup was not: {message}
team.savedTransfers: Saved — {count, plural, one {# transfer} other {# transfers}} made.
team.swapHelpActive: Player selected. Click a player on the other side (pitch ↔ bench) to swap them. Dimmed players would break the formation.
team.swapHelpIdle: Click a shirt, then another player on the opposite side, to swap pitch and bench. Pick captain and vice-captain with the C and V buttons.
team.transferHelp: The × in the corner of a shirt starts a transfer: the player is marked for sale and a list of replacements at his position opens. Nothing is final until you press save.
team.confirmTransfers: Confirm {count, plural, one {# transfer} other {# transfers}}

builder.cleared: Squad cleared. Nothing is written to the database until you press "Save squad".
builder.autoFailed: The automatic pick could not find a valid squad with the current players and budget — build it by hand.
builder.notSaved: Squad was not saved — try again.
builder.finishSwapFirst: Finish the swap before changing formation
builder.swapHelpActive: {name} is selected. Click a player on the other side (pitch ↔ bench) to swap them. Dimmed players would break the formation.
builder.swapHelpIdle: Click a player, then another on the opposite side, to swap them. The formation must stay valid.
builder.captainHint: Pick captain and vice-captain with the C and V buttons under the shirt.
builder.swapHelpIdleFull: Click a player, then another on the opposite side, to swap them. The formation must stay within: 1 goalkeeper, 3–5 defenders, 2–5 midfielders, 1–3 forwards.
builder.captainHintFull: Pick captain and vice-captain with the C and V buttons under the shirt. The captain scores double, and the vice takes over if he doesn't play a single minute.
